phase_source_policy.choice: R-2(i) with amendment A1: exact source identity for every new output; explicit exception limited to the 28 original receipts of the input-compatibility manifest
phase_source_policy.freeze_period: amended source frozen from the fit checkout through chain completion; GPT development isolated and not merged during the chain

amendment_A1.exception: the 12 extraction and 16 benchmark receipts written by the original source are read by the amended source through the pinned manifest; fits, comparisons and summary share the amended source and record the manifest pin
amendment_A1.not_allowed: receipt rewrite; generic accepted-source list; any input not listed; extraction or benchmark by the amended source; a covered source difference outside the closed list
amendment_A1.frozen_text: in the changed Python files every region outside the amended and added definitions keeps its original bytes (decorators, comments and blank lines included) and the top-level statements keep their original order; in the launcher only the replaced lines differ

decision.question: Approvi l'eccezione a R-2(i) sui 28 input e la catena emendata A1?
decision.scope: explicit exception to R-2(i) limited to the 28 original receipts of the pinned input-compatibility manifest; amended chain of 69 classification fits, 3 pose fits, 2 comparisons, 1 summary and 2 checkouts within the unchanged caps of 9 GPU-hours and 1711.666667 core-hours; no other experiment, input or retry

phase_source_policy.invalidation: any further covered source change is another source: the exception and the 28 inputs are not valid under it without a new review and decision
phase_source_policy.action: stop chain; preserve all artifacts; no receipt rewrite or automatic resubmission
phase_source_policy.repeat_requires: new Claude review, new IDs/outputs, complete new estimate and Simone decision; all twelve extractions and sixteen benchmarks repeated
phase_source_policy.additional_cpu: checkout, benchmark and later CPU work must be re-estimated

original_r2i.choice: R-2(i): exact source identity, no cross-source cache reuse
original_r2i.freeze_period: Claude execution childbranch: before first extraction checkout through chain completion; GPTdevelopment isolated and not merged during the chain
original_r2i.invalidation: any covered source change invalidates all twelve extraction receipts under the amended code, including resource-only changes
original_r2i.action: stop chain; preserve all artifacts; no receipt rewrite, accepted-source whitelist or automatic resubmission
original_r2i.repeat_requires: new Claude review, new IDs/outputs, complete new estimate and Simone decision; all twelve extractions repeated
original_r2i.additional_cpu: checkout, benchmark and later CPU work must be re-estimated

numeric_thread_policy.classification_baseline_comparison: historical-libraries-plus-openmp8-v1: same versions/dtype and all historical pools unchanged; only extraOpenMP8allowed; exact_match descriptive; oneexactnumeric_sha256 acrossnewbenchmarks/fits

first_extraction_quota_rule: Claude refreshes both filesystem/quota checks immediately before first extraction submission; no automatic lowering oflimits or retentionextension

classification_numeric_compatibility.name: historical-libraries-plus-openmp8-v1
classification_numeric_compatibility.historical_pools: multiset inclusion with exact equality of all six fields
classification_numeric_compatibility.new_benchmarks_and_fits: one exact numeric_sha256 across all new cells
classification_numeric_compatibility.interpretation: same historical numerical libraries, versions and threads; new process also imports torch; extra OpenMP runtimes do not establish identical fitted predictions

storage_policy.artifact_storage: personal large SCRATCH; all new scientific outputs including caches/OOF/receipts/reports/manifests underoutput_root
storage_policy.intended_retention: less than40days, authorized bySimone05/11evening; owner must complete/export before purge
storage_policy.authorization_quote: si puo scrivere sullo scratch grande? no li terremo per piu di 40 giorni, cosi nonabbimao problemi di spazio
storage_policy.checkpoint_inputs: durable pinned checkpoints remain in WORK; no movement or modification
storage_policy.regeneration_requires: pinned WORKcheckpoints plus original data, calibration, frozen code/config and environment; regeneration is a new compute operation, not an automatic retry or promise of future availability
storage_policy.phase_export: Claude copies receipts, reports, manifests, audits and SLURMaccounting toMac and commits non-payload metadata at end of eachphase before releasingnext; codeSHAandreviewpins preserved
storage_policy.large_payload_policy: cache/OOF/checkpointNPZorPT never committed; optional Macarchive outsideGit, no retention claim beyond SCRATCHpurge without verifiedcopy
storage_policy.scratch_check: fresh filesystem freebytes and inodes; check user/project quota if configured and use tighter availablelimit; include other admitted unfinished outputs tosamefilesystem
storage_policy.work_outputs: four immutable code checkouts and SLURMlogs only; phase metadata also exists as tracked localGitblobs published tocanonicalrepo
storage_policy.work_check: fresh project quota plusinodes; >=8GiBheadroom +1GiBnewcode/log allowance +already-admitted unfinishedWORKoutputs includingFT15; no doublecountbytesalreadywritten
storage_policy.first_submission_rule: Claude refreshes both filesystem/quota checks immediately before first extraction submission; no automatic lowering oflimits or retentionextension
storage_policy.diagnostic_admission_status: historical WORK-only block superseded by explicit SCRATCHdecision; fresh SCRATCHandWORKchecks still required fromClaude
